part1_complete_paired_uncertainty_trajec.methodological_qualification: In task-740, ROUND_0 -> ROUND_1 -> ROUND_2 -> ROUND_3 is a staged self-play curriculum that progressively unlocks Landmark-V2 + SoS + Structural Kernel (Round 1), Multi-Modal 320D + Cross-Attention + CV-Test Gate (Round 2), and Epistemic UCB (Round 3) alongside round-over-round checkpoint weight updates. Therefore, benchmark monotonicity across ROUND_0..ROUND_3 reflects the combined staged system rather than isolated weight-only updates, and all evaluated splits (850-Benchmark, DL-Val, DL-Holdout) are development/diagnostic cohorts.

part2_matched_budget_gradient_direction_.methodological_qualification: Both PROPER_DIR_GRAD_510 and NAIVE_LABEL_GRAFT_510 run for exactly 510 optimizer steps (10 epochs x 51 batches of 24 contexts, 192 candidates/context) from the identical ROUND_1 checkpoint with identical seed (20263000), identical pre-warmed `shared_evo_cache` (0 fallback batches), and `use_cv_test_gate=False`. Because the rollout inference kernel blends neural predictions with the frozen H30/W1 and SoS priors, the single-round paired 98.75% CIs on DL-Val and DL-Holdout overlap zero; we therefore report this strictly as a matched-budget diagnostic sensitivity analysis rather than a standalone statistically significant rollout win.

part4_hwm_vs_new_champions_and_full_jtt1.explanation: In task-740, `new_champions_added: 16` counted the best gate-passing Full-JTT1 candidate appended to `champ_bank` across each of the 16 active contexts per round (including cross-context champion transfers and mutated EditZero children). Moreover, `apply_smart_retention_filter` received `full_eval_results + rest_300`, so `jope.hwm/v1` triggers in round-02 (1) and round-03 (4) were triggered by Stratified-300 (`rest_300`) scores. Here we separate genuinely novel evolved DSLs from bank transfers/replays and verify every HWM candidate on the full original `teacher.jtt1.gz` cut.
